title: bug: the CQ-V08 finalize deferral keys on the pinned profile while strong landings key on strong_landing_task, so a strong journal under a non-verified-local pin finalizes before its receipt
description: finalize_postflight (moe-agent.sh) and Complete-MoePostflight (moe-agent.ps1) defer only when PINNED_ATTEMPT_PROFILE / $script:PinnedAttemptProfile is verified-local, and their CQ-V08b journal removal has the same condition. strong_landing_task / Test-MoeStrongLandingTask, which decide the check-VM route and the strong journal, also return true from the newest attempt record or a leftover strong receipt journal of the task. With a leftover strong journal and an observe pin, a worktree landing writes a strong journal, and an unacknowledged receipt then finalizes landed anyway; the receipt only lands at the next replay. A narrow mixed-profile case found by task-527735ea's self-review. A fix would key both conditions on the journal's own profile (or strong_landing_task).
reopenReason: Governor promotion, 20:32Z. A narrow mixed-profile defect in the CQ-V08 finalize deferral, found by CQ-M07t's self-review. It is in the same receipt/finalize code as task-a1f3723f, so it goes in before the verified-local turn-on row too.

comments.content:
Governor planning input, 20:34Z. This row's DoD is only the placeholder "Task completed as described", so plan to these points and QA reviews against them:
1. In both twins (finalize_postflight in moe-agent.sh, Complete-MoePostflight in moe-agent.ps1), the CQ-V08 finalize deferral and the CQ-V08b journal removal key on the journal's own strong/profile marker, or on strong_landing_task / Test-MoeStrongLandingTask, not on the pinned attempt profile alone.
2. A regression row reproduces the mixed-profile case (a leftover strong journal plus an observe pin, then an unacknowledged receipt) on bash and on PS 5.1 + 7. Before the fix it finalizes landed. After the fix it defers until the receipt is acknowledged. Show a mutant kill.
3. Non-strong landings are unchanged: the existing rows stay green.
4. parity-check stays green, and the gate fits the 20-min rail (scoped, subshell-wrapped refs).
It depends on CQ-M07t (527735ea) and task-a1f3723f, both in the same finalize/receipt code.
